KEY.description: A long random string, for example from `openssl rand -hex 24`. TradingView posts to `https://<worker>/hook/<KEY>` and the MT5 EA uses the same key. Keep it secret.

TG_TOKEN.description: Optional. Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Leave empty for no Telegram posts.

TG_CHAT.description: Optional. Telegram chat or channel id (a channel starts with `-100`). The bot must be an admin there.
